top_signals.title: Norwegian Firm Has $100 Million Riding on Baltic Case
top_signals.summary: As lawyers for Mercuria Energy Group presented the commodity giant’s case against the Baltic Exchange this week, a group of smartly dressed Norwegian businessmen listened intently to the arguments from the back of a packed London courtroom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
